terminals.name: e2e-stack
terminals.command: make e2e-env-up && echo 'E2E stack is healthy' && cd e2e/playwright && docker compose logs -f --tail 0
terminals.description: Boots the E2E stack from e2e/playwright/docker-compose.yml (Mattermost 12.0 at http://mattermost:8065, GitLab CE at http://gitlab.test:8929, Postgres, GitLab runner) and then tails container logs. Wait for 'E2E stack is healthy' before running tests. Run the suite with `make e2e` from the repo root (rebuilds the plugin), or `cd e2e/playwright && npm test` after `make dist`. Filter with `npx playwright test tests/<spec>.spec.ts`. Reset all data with `make e2e-env-down && make e2e-env-up`.
